visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled dark hair and a black button-up shirt stands in a luxurious cosmetic store. He holds a black RODE microphone in his right hand. Behind him, the ceiling is adorned with thousands of hanging crystal beads. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face and clear hand gestures. (2) The camera transitions to show the shop's storefront with the gold 'clé de peau BEAUTÉ' logo on a black facade. The man waves enthusiastically towards the store entrance. Inside, glass cabinets display gold and white skincare bottles under bright warm lighting. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a small black round jar of blush. The man's hands open the lid to reveal pink cream. He uses a brush to apply the product to his cheekbone. The camera then shows a macro close-up of the cream being swatched onto the skin of his forearm, which has a black band tattoo. (4) A second man, dressed in a professional black suit and bow tie, enters the frame and bows deeply. He stands next to the first man, both holding a black loose powder container. They open it to reveal a white, fluffy powder puff. (5) In a different part of the store, the camera shows a round white soap bar resting in a grey glass dish. A hand lathers the soap to create a thick, rich white foam, which is then smoothed over the tattooed arm. Both men laugh and gesture towards the product display. (6) The final scene takes place at a wooden table in a restaurant. The man in the black shirt sits in front of a purple and black shopping bag. He unfolds a white paper napkin featuring handwritten black ink text and looks surprised and delighted at the camera.
